an5.8:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme.
an5.8:1.3: Assaddho bhikkhave bhikkhu cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.8:1.4: ahiriko bhikkhave bhikkhu cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.8:1.5: anottāpī bhikkhave bhikkhu cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.8:1.6: kusīto bhikkhave bhikkhu cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.8:1.7: duppañño bhikkhave bhikkhu cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme.
an5.8:1.8: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme. 3.
an5.8:2.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme.
an5.8:2.3: Saddho bhikkhave bhikkhu na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.8:2.4: hirimā bhikkhave bhikkhu na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.8:2.5: ottāpī bhikkhave bhikkhu na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.8:2.6: āraddhaviriyo bhikkhave bhikkhu na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.8:2.7: paññavā bhikkhave bhikkhu na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme.
an5.8:2.8: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme
